concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-payment-methods-payme-android-component]] — 2026-09-15 PayMe Android Redirect Component v4.0.0+ guide for HK/HKD discovery, redirect return and `/payments/details`, with return-URL casing and sample-language conflicts plus sandbox outcome fixtures.
warnings: The required-field table spells returnURL (raw line 51) while the example uses returnUrl (line 81); do not silently normalize as if the source resolved it.

The payment example is fenced as kotlin but contains Node/JavaScript require and CheckoutAPI code (raw lines 61–93). The final guide link is to Sessions (line 152) although the procedure shows /payments and /payments/details.
The example RedirectShopper and Authorised responses (raw lines 95–150) and amount-ending mappings (lines 156–164) are examples/sandbox fixtures, not live payment or settlement evidence.
